$Comment: Mob Battle training archer: the game's intelligent template (as Skeleton_Archer) with the mannequin body and an iron shortbow. Neutral to players (the template ignores mobs). UseCombatActionEvaluator + CAE_MobBattle_Dummy_Archer: it draws and shoots the player's own shortbow arrows (half and full draw) and fires the Volley signature when its signature energy is full. DesiredAttackDistanceRange keeps it 5-14.5 blocks from its target, so it backs off when one comes closer. Attack (Skeleton_Archer_Bow_Shoot) is only used with the evaluator off.
